```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
#| message: false
# ==============================================================================
# SECTION 1: R BACKEND DATA PIPELINE & PRE-FILTERING (Runs Once at Build)
# All queries and data shaping live in R/setup.R; this chunk runs it and
# broadcasts the resulting structures to OJS.
# ==============================================================================
source("R/setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

# Broadcast In-Memory Data Structures to OJS Space.
# eBay ships pre-aggregated (see R/setup.R §1.11): per-day price arrays + dims
# + per-card 7d unique counts + latest-day item rows — not raw listings.
ojs_define(ojs_movers = movers, ojs_hist = hist_flat, ojs_forecast = forecast_flat, ojs_info = unified, ojs_ebay_daily = ebay_daily, ojs_ebay_dims = ebay_dims, ojs_ebay_counts = ebay_counts, ojs_ebay_card_days = ebay_card_days, ojs_ebay_today = ebay_today, ojs_metrics = backtest_metrics, ojs_global_stats = global_stats, ojs_churn = daily_churn, ojs_signal_metrics = signal_metrics)
```
